company.name: NamasteDev.com
company.tagline: NamasteDev.com is an initiative for sharing our knowledge with the entire tech community. 🙏
company.description:
NamasteDev is dedicated to helping aspiring learners and coders innovate using modern technology and transforming them into efficient front-end and back-end developers. The founder, Akshay Saini, believes in the 'learn by building' principle and focuses on practical, hands-on learning experiences for learners.

NamasteDev offers on-demand learning, expert guidance, certificates upon completion, access to a closed premium community, project-based learning, high-quality videos, assignments, and a comprehensive curriculum. The platform aims to nurture talent and foster innovation, ensuring that developers are equipped to meet the evolving demands of the tech industry and drive the nation forward in the digital age.
